verificationChecks.label: Dependency inventory
verificationChecks.summary: Inventoried 836 source dependencies and 502 packaged dependencies. Exact linked source snapshot and passively extracted installer; no application code executed.

verificationChecks.label: Dependency vulnerability assessment
verificationChecks.summary: High and critical vulnerabilities block publication. Dependency findings: 0 critical, 0 high, 1 medium, 0 low, 0 unknown, 0 info. High and critical findings block publication; lower severities are advisories. Exact linked source snapshot and passively extracted installer; no application code executed. 1 lower-severity or unrated advisories remain; the publisher receives the detailed findings.

verificationChecks.label: Secret patterns in supported files
verificationChecks.summary: Gitleaks checks recognizable credential patterns in supported source/extracted text and passively extracted CPython 3.12 literal constants. Native PE, ELF and Mach-O binaries are skipped. Constants are scanned separately; variable assignments, dynamically assembled values and program behavior are not reconstructed. This is not comprehensive bytecode analysis. 1036 input files were supplied; the inspected-file count is not measured. 0 unreviewed potential embedded credentials remain from 0 original tool matches. Values are never included in reports.

verificationChecks.label: Publisher signing
verificationChecks.summary: Trusted operating-system publisher signing was not established. This release policy permits that disclosed limitation.

verificationChecks.label: Installation and application behavior
verificationChecks.summary: Native installation, launch, update and uninstall testing has not run in this static review.

verificationChecks.label: Comprehensive source analysis
verificationChecks.summary: Dependency and secret scans do not constitute comprehensive source-code or application behavior analysis.

verificationChecks.label: Reproducible build provenance
verificationChecks.summary: Source commit identity is checked; reproducing the binary from source is outside this review.

eligible_artifact.verificationSummary: Automated static checks inspected release and package identity, malware, dependency inventory, vulnerability advisories and potential secrets in supported files. Secret scanning skips native PE, ELF and Mach-O binaries. High and Critical dependency findings block admission; lower-severity advisories remain visible. Review individual results for actual coverage and expiry. Native lifecycle and full source-code security validation are not established by these checks.
